title: Current recording sample rate
text: Harbor currently records microphone audio at 48 kHz. The former 44.1 kHz setting was replaced. Playback speed is independent of this setting.

title: Transcript cache identity
text: A transcript cache entry is keyed by session ID and speaker-map revision. Changing the speaker map makes the earlier cached transcript inapplicable to that revision.

title: Withdrawn publication consent
text: When a participant withdraws publication consent, publishing any session containing that participant is blocked until renewed consent is recorded. An old consent record is insufficient.

title: Waveform preview storage
text: Waveform previews are stored in the session thumbnail directory. Original audio remains in the recording vault. Removing a preview does not remove the original audio.

title: Upload queue declaration
text: The Lakeside session is queued for upload to the archive. A queue entry describes intended work. Successful upload requires a receipt from the archive service.

title: Lakeside upload evidence
text: The Lakeside evidence bundle contains its upload queue entry. It contains no archive-service upload receipt and no observation of the archived recording.

title: Public stream approval
text: Starting a public stream requires a recorded release from the consent coordinator. A producer request cannot replace the release. A private rehearsal does not authorize a public stream.

title: Evening stream request
text: The producer requested a public stream of the evening session. No consent-coordinator release is recorded for that stream.

title: Transcript language routing
text: Verified Spanish speech uses transcription profile S. Verified English speech uses profile E. The speech language must be verified before a profile is assigned.

title: Session Sol language record
text: The session is titled Sol. Its verified speech-language field is empty. Session titles do not establish the language spoken in a recording.

title: Marker shortcut decision record
text: The current shortcut for inserting a marker is Alt+M. The available records contain no decision note explaining the choice of this shortcut.

title: Retired microphone setting
text: The earlier microphone recording setting was 44.1 kHz. That historical setting has been superseded. It does not specify the current recording configuration.

title: Package scan prerequisite
text: Before a package scan starts, the operator must record a verified checksum for that package. A checksum from another package does not satisfy the prerequisite. Urgent scans are not exempt.

title: Former artifact retention
text: The former artifact retention period was 60 days. This historical policy has been replaced and does not govern newly stored artifacts.

title: Current artifact retention
text: The current confirmed artifact retention period is 21 days. It supersedes the former 60-day policy. An unconfirmed proposal for seven days has no effect.

title: Directory labels and ownership
text: A directory display label is descriptive, not an ownership assignment. The maintainer registry is the authority for accountable ownership; a team-like label alone does not establish a maintainer.

title: Dependency graph interpretation
text: The dependency graph shows that Indexer calls Parser. It records a code relationship, not why that dependency was chosen. No design decision explaining this relationship is in the supplied records.

title: Incident cache hypothesis
text: An engineer suspects the shared cache caused the Mosaic incident. This is an unverified observation, not a confirmed cause.

title: Mosaic incident conclusion
text: The confirmed Mosaic incident review leaves the root cause undetermined. No proposed explanation has been confirmed. The review does not rule out the shared cache.

title: External report review rule A
text: A confirmed current instruction says external reports require review by the release lead before delivery. Its scope covers all external reports. No supersession is recorded.

title: External report review rule B
text: Another confirmed current instruction says external reports require no review before delivery. Its scope covers all external reports. No supersession or precedence between these instructions is recorded.

title: Vault download prerequisite
text: Downloading a restricted vault artifact requires a recorded grant from the security custodian. A request from the artifact author does not provide that grant.

title: Amber artifact request
text: The author requested download of the restricted Amber artifact. No security-custodian grant is recorded for that download.

title: Review attachment storage
text: Review attachments are retained in the review evidence store. The build cache holds compiled outputs instead. Clearing the build cache does not remove review attachments.
